form.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
form.label: GitHub Personal Access Token (for private repos)

form.name: DOCUMENT_ROOT
form.label: DocumentRoot (e.g. public for Laravel or . for root)

command:
apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git unzip libzip-dev libpng-dev libonig-dev libxml2-dev curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker-php-ext-install pdo pdo_mysql mbstring zip gd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; a2enmod rewrite >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if ! command -v composer >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -sS https://getcomposer.org/installer | php -- --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; cd /var/www/html; if [ -n "$GIT_REPOSITORY_URL" ]; then AUTH_REPO_URL="$GIT_REPOSITORY_URL"; if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then AUTH_REPO_URL=$(echo "$GIT_REPOSITORY_URL" | sed -E "s#https://#https://${GITHUB_TOKEN}@#"); fi; if [ ! -d .git ]; then echo '[Runner] Clonando repositório PHP...'; git clone --branch "$GIT_BRANCH" "$AUTH_REPO_URL" . ; else echo '[Runner] Atualizando repositório PHP...'; git remote set-url origin "$AUTH_REPO_URL"; git fetch origin "$GIT_BRANCH"; git checkout "$GIT_BRANCH"; git pull origin "$GIT_BRANCH"; fi; else if [ ! -f index.php ] && [ ! -f public/index.php ]; then echo '[Runner] Criando index.php demo...'; mkdir -p public; cat << 'EOF' > public/index.php
<?php
header('Content-Type: application/json');
echo json_encode([
    'status' => 'online',
    'runtime' => 'PHP ' . PHP_VERSION,
    'message' => 'ServApp PHP/Laravel ativo no Cosmos-Server'
]);
EOF
fi; fi; if [ -f composer.json ] && [ -n "$INSTALL_CMD" ]; then echo "[Runner] Executando: $INSTALL_CMD"; eval "$INSTALL_CMD"; fi; if [ -n "$BUILD_CMD" ]; then echo "[Runner] Executando: $BUILD_CMD"; eval "$BUILD_CMD"; fi; TARGET_DOCROOT="/var/www/html"; if [ -d "/var/www/html/$DOCUMENT_ROOT" ]; then TARGET_DOCROOT="/var/www/html/$DOCUMENT_ROOT"; fi; sed -ri -e "s!/var/www/html!$TARGET_DOCROOT!g" /etc/apache2/sites-available/*.conf; sed -ri -e "s!/var/www/!$TARGET_DOCROOT!g" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf /etc/apache2/conf-available/*.conf; cat << 'EOF' > /etc/apache2/conf-available/override.conf
<Directory /var/www/html/>
    Options Indexes FollowSymLinks
    AllowOverride All
    Require all granted
</Directory>
EOF
a2enconf override >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html 2>/dev/null || true; echo '[Runner] Iniciando Apache com PHP 8.4...'; exec apache2-foreground

routes.name: {ServiceName}
routes.description: Rota principal HTTP do ServApp PHP/Laravel
